text:
mira: RFC follow-up: propose we augment canary decisions with a tiny per-request "RiskVector" computed at the router. not a heavy ML signal, just cheap heuristics from the request.

mira: motivation: some failures only show up for certain inputs (huge attachments, chains of tool calls, unusual feature flags). waiting for controller-side metrics can be too slow. local fast fallback avoids customer-visible errors.

oz: makes sense. question: what exactly goes over the wire? we need a strict privacy-safe contract for hosted and private.

raj: suggested contract: router emits RiskVector JSON-lite: latency_risk (0-1), cost_risk (0-1), quality_risk (0-1), fingerprint_hash. no raw prompt text leaves the host unless sampling+consent. fingerprint_hash must be per-deployment salted.

taylor: agree on salt + sampling. also add a boolean "embeddings_requested" and "attachment_count" to the vector. all primitives, low CPU.

mira: decision flow sketch: 1) router computes RiskVector synchronously. 2) If latency_risk > local_threshold -> immediate local fallback. 3) else it forwards RiskVector and route metadata to controller while proceeding normally. controller provides a canary_score aggregated over window.

oz: ops concerns: we need sub-ms path for RiskVector. keep checks to integer/bool ops (token_count, flags_count, attachment_flag). no regex on the whole body.

raj: add stability guards: controller only flips a route when score has been above threshold for cooldown_secs and observations >= min_samples. also add rollback hysteresis to avoid oscillation.

taylor: sample policy snippet (pseudo):
canary_policy = {window_secs:600, sample_rate:0.05, local_thresholds:{latency:0.9, cost:0.95}, min_samples:50, cooldown_secs:120}

mira: telemetry plan: router sends RiskVector counts to local aggregator. central telemetry only receives aggregates (counts/histogram) and sampled full payloads (0.01) with PII redaction.

oz: private deployment mode: support a "local-only" flag so tenants can opt out of controller calls entirely. in that mode, controller endpoints are disabled and decisions run 100% on router config.

raj: API proto notes: RiskVector message should be tiny and versioned. include schema_version + deployment_salt_hash to allow safe validation.

taylor: test plan: chaos run that injects heavy attachments + simulated slow GPU variants, ensure fallback triggers locally within 200ms and no controller flip if isolated spike.

deploy-bot: canary policy applied to svc=text-gen-staging (deploy-4310) :rocket:

mira: next actions: I'll add privacy appendix and proto draft. @oz takes router changes, @raj controller scoring + hysteresis, @taylor telemetry + ops dashboards.

oz: taking router. timeline: PR next week.

raj: will prototype scoring algo (weighted risk + decayed window) by EOD Friday.

taylor: will draft SLOs for false-positive fallback rate and telemetry sampling thresholds.

mira: thanks everyone. will post RFC patch and short demo gif in the thread. :thumbsup:
